SUBJECT 01 / NUMBER THEORY

Where counting meets the unexpected.

Ask a question about whole numbers and you may find yourself drawing a curve, studying a symmetry, or changing the world of numbers you work in. Number theory is our first long path through mathematical invention.

Begin with elliptic curves ↗
FIRST EXHIBITION OPEN NOW

How can one point
generate more?

Start with a curve and two rational points. A line drawn through them makes a third point visible. Reflect it, then ask why the result is rational again. This geometric move becomes an addition law.

Try the experiment ↗
